Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.reservation.simulation

Klasse FileReservationAPI

java.lang.Object
ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.reservation.simulation.FileReservationAPI
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
ReservationAPI
public class FileReservationAPI extends Object implements ReservationAPI
File-based implementation of the ReservationAPI interface.

This implementation reads reservation data from a given file and caches it in memory. The data file should contain an array of reservation entries, each with a room ID and a list of time windows during which the room is reserved.

The class supports both a custom file path and a default path (src/main/resources/jsonData/ReservationData.json).

  • Konstruktordetails

    • FileReservationAPI

      public FileReservationAPI(Path userFilePath) throws IOException
      Constructs a FileReservationAPI with a custom JSON file path.

      If the provided file path is invalid or the file does not exist, the implementation will fall back to the default JSON file path.

      Parameter:
      userFilePath - the path to the JSON file containing reservation data
      Löst aus:
      IOException - if neither the provided file nor the default file can be read

  • Methodendetails

    • getReservations

      public List<RoomReservation> getReservations()
      Returns all reservations for all rooms in the system.

      Each element in the returned list represents the reservation data for a single room that has at least one reservation. Rooms without reservations are not included in the list.

      Angegeben von:
      getReservations in Schnittstelle ReservationAPI
      Gibt zurück:
      a list of RoomReservation objects, one for each room with reservations; never null, but may be empty if no rooms have reservations
